A packaged symbolic/numerical checker confirms representative algebra and values but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: An invariant genetic-fiber relaxation spectrum is a natural observable and interaction rates are meaningful model parameters. Spectrum-only identification even under repeated rates determines a complete inverse invariant, not a single numerical example. The vanishing-hub limit shows an otherwise disconnected leaf graph acquires a complete-graph effective interaction through rare central transitions; quantitative two-scale convergence and interlacing describe the associated genuine dynamical mechanism.
